design: prespecified analyses on previously inspected retrospective development cohorts; not confirmation

selective.reference_unit: known ECG-endpoint opportunity; mapped statement presence/absence in SPH; explicit known reference in LUDB
selective.primary: frozen joint accepted minus no-abstention risk and frozen joint minus expected random equal-coverage risk
selective.interval: 98.75% percentile per primary contrast (four comparisons, Bonferroni); 95% descriptive elsewhere
selective.policy: use original cutoffs, one decision per ECG; alternatives are label-blind and keep the frozen number of accepted scored ECGs
selective.random: analytical expected counts under uniform selection without replacement; no Monte Carlo policy selection
selective.cost: emitted errors plus lambda times withheld known opportunities per original scored known opportunity; technical failures separate

morphology.architecture: classwise equal-width frozen representation plus 32-unit ReLU MLP, SGD, train-only standardization
morphology.effect_margin_basis: two absolute macro-F1 points is the prespecified minimum engineering interest, not a clinical margin
morphology.interval: 98.333% percentile over paired ECG/patient components for three profile contrasts; seeds averaged in each resample, not treated as independent test sets
morphology.precision: fixed existing eligible data; report realized interval width against the 0.02 margin; no precision or equivalence claim based on a null test
morphology.eligibility: reuse sealed matched features and original splits; require train and calibration minimum polarity and both polarities held; same records and weights across arms
morphology.scope: new nonlinear heads with matched fixed backbone features generated by intervening before backbone and head; does not estimate full-network retraining or historical weight effects
morphology.transfer: Chapman rhythm and PTB-XL pathology are different tasks; no same-target cross-source comparison; no fold 10 and no new external gate access
